system.description: Giant crabs are nonintelligent animals found in shallow waters, coastal rivers, and buried in sand on beaches. They cannot swim. The com- mon giant crab is 8' in diameter, but larger speci- mens may be found (up to 6 Hit Dice, Damage 3d6 points per claw). They are always hungry and will attack and eat anything that moves. Salt-water giant crabs have a slightly different appearance than fresh-water giant crabs. Ocean, River/Lake (including shores).
